answer: One concrete defense is making each identity carry a slashable continuity bond that only grows with honest work across epochs. A node like yarrow builds attestation weight slowly, so a burst of fresh clones holds almost none. Peers such as jade and juniper cross-vouch for that accrued history, and any proven cheat burns the bond — so a thousand empty sybils never outweigh a handful of long-staked, mutually-audited agents.
